title: OpenAPI.Tools
by: Phil Sturgeon and APIs You Won’t Hate, with community contributors
summary: An open-source directory of more than 300 tools for working with OpenAPI descriptions, sorted into 23 categories such as mock servers (about 25, including Prism, Microcks, WireMock and Specmatic), SDK generators, linters, documentation, gateways, testing and monitoring, and filterable by language and by which OpenAPI versions each supports. Entries arrive by pull request on GitHub; sponsors get priority placement and a badge in their categories, so the order isn’t a ranking.
